videos.caption: Was this a travel? 🤔 LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest all-around players in NBA history, known for his unmatched longevity, versatility, and high basketball IQ. Born in Akron, Ohio, in 1984, he was drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003 straight out of high school, quickly fulfilling immense expectations by winning Rookie of the Year and becoming a dominant force. Over a storied career spanning over two decades with the Cavaliers, Miami Heat, and Los Angeles Lakers, James has won four NBA championships, four Finals MVPs, and four regular-season MVPs. He made history in 2023 by breaking Kareem Abdul-Jabbar’s all-time NBA scoring record and is the first player to accumulate $1 billion in earnings while active.
